artwork.name: Pet It Be B1 front cream 11in

locations.note: Front only. Artwork 11 inches wide by 11 inches tall, proportional, centered on the chest, top approximately 3 inches below the collar seam. Use the exact cream artwork. Print only the cream ink; transparent areas must show the Maroon cloth. No backing rectangle, recolor, gloss, redraw, extra text or print on any other location. Keep a matte, fabric-integrated finish. Scale down only if required for the smallest size.

apliiq.productionNote: Pet It Be cream one-color front artwork on Maroon Independent SS3000 crewneck. Current AHA private label inside neck.

product.description: An 8.5 oz midweight crewneck sweatshirt in Maroon with a cream front print of the Pet It Be neighborhood pet shop. It has a standard fit, a cotton face, neck tape, and ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband.
